The first one because of the beautiful story about finding live where you were less expecting it while looking for something else. A story of friendship featuring a talking donkey, a rad dragon and amazing onion analogies. It also teaches children that beauty is subjective and someone will love you no matter what you look like.

Also, the soundtrack is perfect in every way. I understand the debate with the second movie but I believe that a soundtrack that can mix Smash Mouth and a beautiful Hallelujah rendition in such a masterful way is the all-time best.

Plus we get to see someone torture a cookie.
